text:
ashley: Heads up — HelioMetrics (acct HL-442) popped up at 58 days past due on INV-2025-900 ($96,000). CS says CFO called asking to convert $48k to account credit for future Dedicated capacity and pay remaining $48k over 3 months. They also asked us not to suspend their Dedicated pool while arrangement is negotiated. cc @pete @leila

pete: any usage disputes or credits?

leila: no disputed charges in portal. customer mentions last-week incident affecting ingestion but they didn't file a ticket. we should verify service incident before allowing credit.

omkar: Finance here 2: conservative approach: we can accept split payment but converting invoice principal to credit requires incident verification + Rev approval. If we allow credit, it must be applied to future invoices only (non-refundable) and documented in PA. Also require PA + upfront 30% of remaining principal.

ashley: customer emailed acceptance screenshot: "we'll take $48k in credit if you confirm outage remediation and keep capacity live; will pay $16k/mo for 3 months starting on receipt of PA." attached in #customer-docs.

pete: collections: we can hold suspension for 14 days while we validate incident and draft PA. require ACH or card token and a signed PA with auto-charge for installments. If they fail payment, immediate suspension of Dedicated resources after 3-day cure.

leila: ops to check incident history and confirm remediation status. if no outage, we deny credit request and offer standard split only.

billing-bot: Created invoice revision INV-2025-900.rev1 and queued PA template. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2025-900/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Placed temporary hold on resource suspension for HL-442 while PA and incident verification pending. Reminder scheduled in 10 days.

omkar: Approve conditional split: require upfront 30% ($14,400) of the $48k principal they propose to convert? wait math: original $96k, customer wants $48k credit + $48k split. For clarity: we require $14,400 upfront on the $48k payable portion, signed PA, and incident verification for the credit piece. Omkar final sign-off after upfront clears.

sales-bot: Sales notes uploaded: CFO committed on call to provide ACH and sign PA. asks for invoice that separates credit from payable principal.

ashley: I'll coordinate with Ops to confirm incident and then send PA with separate line items: credit hold $48k (pending incident verification), payable principal $48k with 3-month schedule. PA will state credit only applied after Ops confirmation and not refundable.

pete: once upfront posts, update ledger and remove delinquency flag; collections will monitor. If they don't post upfront in 7 business days, hold removed and standard escalation resumes.

leila: Ops confirmed a short ingestion delay last week, mitigations applied, root cause identified. recommend approving the credit contingent on customer acknowledging incident and closing any open monitoring tickets.

omkar: OK to proceed per above. Omkar to sign off after we see txn id for upfront 30% and signed PA. Finance will apply credit to future Dedicated invoices only after Ops confirms remediation and customer acknowledges closure.

ashley: sending PA + revised invoice to HelioMetrics now with 7-business-day deadline for upfront. will post update when PA returned. :mailboat:
